#Mean dFF across first 2 s
```{r}
# =========================
# Libraries
# =========================
library(pacman)
p_load(tidyverse, readr, lmerTest, emmeans)

# =========================
# Load data
# =========================
df <- read_csv("NE_Social_post2s_mean_dff.csv")

# =========================
# Filter for Social_interaction ONLY
# =========================
# df <- df %>%
#   filter(behavior == "Social_interaction")

df <- df %>%
  filter(behavior == "Social_interaction", week != "W3")

# =========================
# Format variables
# =========================
df$week <- as.factor(df$week)
df$mouse_id <- as.factor(df$mouse_id)

# Ensure correct order
df$week <- factor(df$week,
                  levels = c("Preinduction", "W1", "W2", "W3"))

# =========================
# Linear mixed model
# =========================
m_anova <- lmerTest::lmer(mean_dFF ~ week + (1 | mouse_id), data = df)

summary(m_anova)
# Emmeans + Dunnett contrasts
# =========================
emmeans_results <- emmeans(m_anova, ~ week)

dunnett_results <- contrast(
  emmeans_results,
  method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
  ref = 1
)

dunnett_table <- as.data.frame(summary(dunnett_results, infer = TRUE))
print(dunnett_table)

# =========================
# SIGNIFICANCE ANNOTATION (DUNNETT)
# =========================

#dunnett_table$group <- c("W1", "W2", "W3")
dunnett_table$group <- c("W1", "W2")

# =========================
# Summary stats for plotting
# =========================
summary_df <- df %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(mean_dFF, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(mean_dFF, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# y-position above bars
y_max <- max(summary_df$mean + summary_df$se)

# dunnett_table$y <- c(
#   y_max * 1.20,
#   y_max * 1.30,
#   y_max * 1.40
# )
dunnett_table$y <- c(
  y_max * 1.80,
  y_max * 2.00
)

dunnett_table$label <- case_when(
  dunnett_table$p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
  dunnett_table$p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
  dunnett_table$p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
  TRUE ~ "ns"
)
dunnett_table

# =========================
# Summary stats for plotting
# =========================
summary_df <- df %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(mean_dFF, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(mean_dFF, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =========================
# Plot
# =========================
library(ggplot2)

plot_bar <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = week, y = mean, fill = week)) +

  geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "black", alpha = 0.85) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    data = df,
    aes(x = week, y = mean_dFF),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    width = 0.00,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data = df,
    aes(x = week, y = mean_dFF, group = mouse_id),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "gray60",
    alpha = 0.4,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Preinduction" = "#feca8d",
    "W1" = "#f1605d",
    "W2" = "#440f76"
  )) +

  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Mean ΔF/F"
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    text = element_text(size = 14)
  )+
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, 10))+
  geom_text(
  data = dunnett_table,
  aes(x = group, y = y, label = label),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  size = 5
)

plot_bar

# =========================
# Save figure
# =========================
ggsave(
  "NE_SocialInteraction_barplot_Socialcond.svg",
  plot = plot_bar,
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# =========================
# Model diagnostics
# =========================
p_load(performance)
check_model(m_anova)

qqnorm(residuals(m_anova))
qqline(residuals(m_anova))

shapiro.test(residuals(m_anova))

```

#Mean dFF across entire behaviour
```{r}
# =========================
# Libraries
# =========================
library(pacman)
p_load(tidyverse, readr, lmerTest, emmeans)

# =========================
# Load data
# =========================
df <- read_csv("NE_Social_post2s_mean_dff.csv")

# =========================
# Filter for Social_interaction ONLY
# =========================
# df <- df %>%
#   filter(behavior == "Novel_interaction")

df <- df %>%
  filter(behavior == "Novel_interaction", week != "W3")

# =========================
# Format variables
# =========================
df$week <- as.factor(df$week)
df$mouse_id <- as.factor(df$mouse_id)

# Ensure correct order
df$week <- factor(df$week,
                  levels = c("Preinduction", "W1", "W2", "W3"))

# =========================
# Linear mixed model
# =========================
m_anova <- lmerTest::lmer(mean_dFF ~ week + (1 | mouse_id), data = df)

summary(m_anova)
# Emmeans + Dunnett contrasts
# =========================
emmeans_results <- emmeans(m_anova, ~ week)

dunnett_results <- contrast(
  emmeans_results,
  method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
  ref = 1
)

dunnett_table <- as.data.frame(summary(dunnett_results, infer = TRUE))
print(dunnett_table)

# =========================
# SIGNIFICANCE ANNOTATION (DUNNETT)
# =========================

dunnett_table$group <- c("W1", "W2")
#dunnett_table$group <- c("W1", "W2", "W3")

# y-position above bars
y_max <- max(summary_df$mean + summary_df$se)

dunnett_table$y <- c(
  y_max * 2.20,
  y_max * 2.30
)
# dunnett_table$y <- c(
#   y_max * 1.20,
#   y_max * 1.30,
#   y_max * 1.40
# )

dunnett_table$label <- case_when(
  dunnett_table$p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
  dunnett_table$p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
  dunnett_table$p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
  TRUE ~ "ns"
)
dunnett_table

# =========================
# Summary stats for plotting
# =========================
summary_df <- df %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(mean_dFF, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(mean_dFF, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =========================
# Plot
# =========================
library(ggplot2)

plot_bar <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = week, y = mean, fill = week)) +

  geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "black", alpha = 0.85) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, 10))+

  geom_jitter(
    data = df,
    aes(x = week, y = mean_dFF),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    width = 0.00,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data = df,
    aes(x = week, y = mean_dFF, group = mouse_id),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "gray60",
    alpha = 0.4,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Preinduction" = "#feca8d",
    "W1" = "#f1605d",
    "W2" = "#440f76"
  )) +

  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Mean ΔF/F"
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    text = element_text(size = 14)
  )+
  geom_text(
  data = dunnett_table,
  aes(x = group, y = y, label = label),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  size = 5
)

plot_bar

# =========================
# Save figure
# =========================
ggsave(
  "NE_NovelInteraction_barplot_SocialCond.svg",
  plot = plot_bar,
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# =========================
# Model diagnostics
# =========================
check_model(m_anova)

qqnorm(residuals(m_anova))
qqline(residuals(m_anova))

shapiro.test(residuals(m_anova))
```
